Checklist.closeOutRequested: Sent to your manager. Leave this checklist for now.
Checklist.closeOutPendingNotice: You already asked to close this checklist. A manager is reviewing it.

Install.ctaTitle: Install StayCheck for faster, full-screen access.
Install.iosBanner: Add StayCheck to your Home Screen →
Install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
Install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen."
Install.iosStep3: Tap "Add," then open StayCheck from your Home Screen.
